Bug Report: buttons unresponsive
Repository: https://github.com/esokullu/webbrain
Title: buttons unresponsive
Issue: Buttons on the web interface are unresponsive (not clickable or not reacting to interactions).

Steps to reproduce:
1. Navigate to the esokullu/webbrain repository on GitHub.
2. Locate the buttons in the UI (likely in the webbrain tool interface).
3. Attempt to click or interact with the buttons.
4. Observe that the buttons do not respond to clicks.

Expected behavior: Buttons should be clickable and trigger their associated actions.
Actual behavior: Buttons are unresponsive.

Suggested fix: Investigate the frontend code (likely JavaScript/TypeScript) that handles button click events. Check for:
- Missing event listeners
- Incorrect event delegation
- Asynchronous operations blocking the UI
- Incorrect state management

Reference: GitHub repository https://github.com/esokullu/webbrain
